'''Brinojja''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="Soulsaber" /> who operated as a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Hutt employed the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Verkoss]] as the chief enforcer for Brinojja's crime operation and in<ref name="Soulsaber" /> [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure ''[[Child of Light]]'' is set four [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], an event dated by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to the sixth month of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. As the ''Atlas'' states that there are twelve months in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]], it can therefore be inferred that ''Child of Light'' takes place in the tenth month of 3 ABY. [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']] is set approximately four months after ''Child of Light'' and can thus be dated to the second month of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Brinojja sent Verkoss and a group of thugs to apprehend the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Information broker/Legends|information merchant]] [[Rat (Human)|Rat]] from a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents assisted Rat in escaping from Brinojja's thugs and the information broker was subsequently grateful to the Rebels for saving him from the Hutt.<ref name="Soulsaber" />

==Behind the scenes==
Brinojja was first mentioned in [[Soulsaber (adventure)|''Soulsaber'']], a [[2001]] [[RPGA]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Lee Pickler]] and set within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity that served as the second installment of the [[Child of Light saga|''Child of Light'' saga]].<ref name="Soulsaber" /> The Hutt was subsequently referenced in the final adventure of the ''Child of Light'' saga, [[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']], in [[2002]].<ref name="Light and Dark" /> Brinojja's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] is not confirmed in either source.<ref name="Soulsaber" /><ref name="Light and Dark" />
